references.text: The same chapter establishes the right of the avenger of blood to kill the murderer, which is repeated in verse 21.
The preceding verses describe various weapons of murder (iron, stone, wood) that lead to the death penalty, paralleled with striking someone with the hand in enmity.
The fundamental principle that whoever sheds human blood shall have their own blood shed by humans is established here.
The law that whoever strikes a man so that he dies shall be put to death confirms the death penalty for murder.
The principle of life for life in cases of killing is repeated in the Mosaic Law.
Parallel legislation concerning a man who hates his neighbor and strikes him down, and that the elders shall deliver him to the avenger of blood.
Joab killed Abner and Amasa under a pretense of peace with warlike bloodshed, an example of blood vengeance in practice.
